text:
maria (partnerships): quick sync — thinking about a commit-velocity incentive for marketplace private offers. idea: channel credits (SI/co-sell) are gated and only released after onboarding milestones to avoid premature heavy discounts. open to pushback.
aj (sales): makes sense. long tail of SI promos has been killing our renewal rates. what exactly are you proposing as gates? :thinking_face:
maria (partnerships): three candidates: 1) first invoice paid, 2) 90-day usage >= 30% of committed spend, 3) hw-bundle verified installed + SI runbook signoff. release credits in tranches at each milestone.
kai (product): i like the tiered-release idea. suggests we A/B test with two cohorts: tranche vs. upfront. also add a lightweight telemetry flag so we can attribute downstream retention to the gate.
olivia (revops): watch revenue recognition. if credits are held back they may change how we book marketplace revenue. recommend a "credit lockbox" ledger where credits are visible but not applied until release event. finance needs the config before we go live.
sam (legal): need to make sure the gating doesn't look like discriminatory pricing or unfair channel lock-in. also add explicit language in the private offer T&Cs about credit release contingencies and hardware-warranty tie-ins. i'll draft a template clause.
nina (hw-partner): from our side, predictable delivery windows are huge. we're fine with verification-based release if partner exec sponsor signs off. can we include a co-marketing kicker when the hw bundle is installed (e.g., extra 5% credits after joint announcement)? :+1:
ben (eng): to make the telemetry simple, we can emit a webhook when the onramp checklist is marked complete. example payload: ```{\n  "customer_id": "C-12345",\n  "milestone": "hw_installed",\n  "timestamp": "2026-06-15T18:22:00Z"\n}``` we'll also expose a small API to query credit balance per private-offer id.
maria (partnerships): perfect — olivia + ben can you pair on the lockbox API schema? aj, nina — want to pilot one enterprise this quarter?
aj (sales): i have a mid-market SI-led account ready to convert. pilot would be perfect. i'll loop in AE and SI PM.
olivia (revops): pairing ok. ben i'll DM for API fields. we need clear ledgers: total credits offered, released, pending, and expiry. expiry defaults to 12 months unless renewal-triggered.
sam (legal): drafting clause now. will add a short FAQ for marketplace listing to make the gating transparent to buyers and partners.
nina (hw-partner): we'll commit to a joint announcement window once the first tranche releases. can we get a calendar target?
maria (partnerships): target: pilot offer live by 2026-07-10, first verification window ends by 2026-10-10, announce co-sell by 2026-10-20.
deploy-bot: doc created — https://redwood.internal/partnerships/commit-velocity-incentive-draft (private).
aj (sales): :thumbsup: will prep the AE brief and SI onboarding checklist items.
kai (product): one ask — allow a manual override for ops for edge cases (fraud, provisioning delays).
maria (partnerships): agreed. ops override with audit trail only. i'll consolidate action items and share a draft PR for the private-offer template tomorrow.
ben (eng): putting a stub endpoint on staging today to support the pilot. will add test events for the webhook.
nina (hw-partner): thanks — excited to try this.
maria (partnerships): thanks team — next steps: olivia+ben API, sam legal clause, aj customer pilot, kai ops override UX. will schedule a 30m sync next week to lock the rollout plan.
